verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is a banking-as-a-service API, and a product like this could plausibly offer natural-language operation (an AI assistant or agent interface), so the axis applies. The evidence only shows API-key-authenticated REST endpoints, command-line or Postman testing, and an llms.txt docs index. These are developer building blocks and adjacent documentation features, not a documented capability to operate the product with natural-language commands.
